topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its main learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor virology and experimental cell transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the investigation of tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and the development of assays to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer-associated mutations in oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes alter cell cycle checkpoints and cellular phenotype.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the repair defects, replication errors, and mitotic abnormalities that give rise to sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sequential mutation accumulation and inherited gene defects accelerate cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture, invites questions, and recommends supplementary reading.
